THIS IS A HYPOTHESIS ABOUT THE TARGET, NOT A FACT ABOUT HIM.

sources.content: 149 tweets, Feb 2021 - Apr 2023, plus 16 distilled principles
sources.note: Byte-identical to the file previously committed as source_analysis.docx

sources.content: 119 pages: 245 tweet screenshots, 85 annotated charts, 76 mixed
sources.note: Almost no text layer (137 chars) - the content IS the images. Contains tweets ABSENT from the docx, e.g. fading listing pumps on IOTX/TRU/CLV/MNGO/AXS.
The corpus is not only Twitter: img251 and img282 are DISCORD posts from a private group, with content absent from the tweet archive.

principles.name: Low unit bias
principles.claim: Retail is magnetically drawn to low-unit-price coins.

principles.name: Schelling points
principles.claim: Round numbers act as support/resistance, especially absent any valuation rationale.
principles.evidence: Blotter sizes: -280,000 RLC, -47,000 GTC, -27,000 AVAX, -90,000 BAND, -233,000 BAKE, -12,000 ETC (img089/096/097). Also two deliberately off-round sizes, -999,999 ADA and -19,001 ETC. img112 names it as the trade reason outright: round schelling point number plus thick sells above was 'a bit too tempting'.

principles.name: Never short small caps
principles.claim: Do not short micro/small caps; supply can be cornered after seller exhaustion.
principles.caveat: CONTRADICTED BY HIS OWN POSTS. A screenshot-only tweet describes fading listing pumps on IOTX, TRU, CLV, MNGO, AXS - all small caps. The rule appears to mean 'do not short cornered, exhausted small caps', not 'never short anything small'. Do not treat a small-cap short as a contradiction on its own. CORROBORATED BY THE BLOTTERS: he simultaneously held shorts in RLC, GRT, EGLD, BAKE, SRM, GTC and BAND.

principles.name: Momentum persistence
principles.claim: Strong stays strong; cutting winners to add to losers is backwards.

principles.name: Fading DOGE pumps
principles.claim: Fading DOGE pumps was among the highest hit-rate trades post-SNL.

principles.name: Intuition over analysis
principles.claim: Edge is intuition, not chart-drawing or complex strategy.

principles.name: New vs old coins
principles.claim: New coins beat old ones: hope, no bagholders, motivated teams.

principles.name: News reaction trading
principles.claim: How the market reacts to news matters more than whether the news is true.

principles.name: Risk timing
principles.claim: Maximise risk early in an alt cycle and reduce over time.

principles.name: Long-term conviction
principles.claim: Most with long horizons should hold BTC and ETH rather than trade.

principles.name: Hedged alt book
principles.claim: Wrote about shorting weaker alts against favoured longs and being 'delta neutral' (img282, Dec 2021).
principles.caveat: CONTRADICTED BY HIS OWN BLOTTERS. img089 is 8 shorts against one ~$1k SUSHI long; img096 is 7 shorts and nothing else; img097 is 6 shorts and a single long the review's compiler circled 'long?' because it stood out. Delta-neutral is a phase he rotates into after booking profits, not his standing structure. A one-sided short book is NOT evidence against him — an earlier check_hedged_book scored it CONTRADICTS and was removed for exactly that.

principles.name: Funding arbitrage
principles.claim: Prefers funding-rate arbitrage over smart-contract yield farming.

principles.name: Alt/BTC ratio framing
principles.claim: Analyses alts denominated in BTC, not only USD.
principles.evidence: img292.jpg - six-panel SOLBTC/ADABTC/DOTBTC/AVAXBTC/FTMBTC/ALGOBTC chart marking an alt top

principles.name: Fade listing pumps
principles.claim: Shorts newly listed futures into the listing pump.
principles.evidence: img150.jpg - tweet naming IOTX, TRU, CLV, MNGO, AXS

principles.name: Long panic sells
principles.claim: Buys panic sells from DeFi exploits; the market forgets within hours.

principles.name: Bear at heart
principles.claim: Self-described bear; did his best work in the 2018-2019 bear market.
principles.caveat: DIRECTION IS REGIME, NOT IDENTITY. img007 is an FTX grouped-positions panel with BTC, ETH and SUSHI all LONG and $2.19M open. He wrote 'Remember to never short in a bull market' (img020), 'Ok, back to degen longing' (img022) and 'Exceptionally rare I'll short alts in THESE CONDITIONS' (img011). A long book is NOT evidence against him — check_net_short_bias no longer returns CONTRADICTS.

principles.name: Broad simultaneous short basket
principles.claim: Runs seven to nine alt shorts at once, cross-margined at 1x-5x, rather than one concentrated bet.

principles.name: Short supply-unlock events
principles.claim: Shorts into listing pumps and airdrop unlocks, and exits fast.
principles.evidence: img150 (IOTX/TRU/CLV/MNGO/AXS listings), img226 (dYdX airdrop: 'going to close here for pennies... don't love the rr of holding this open too long')
principles.note: Not yet implemented — would need entry timing against listing dates.

principles.name: Nearly unliquidatable
principles.claim: Runs low leverage on cross margin so positions cannot be liquidated out of him; willing to sit through large drawdowns.
principles.evidence: img013 ('Nearly impossible to liquidate me... ready to hold this open for months'); blotters at 1x-5x cross (img049/089/096/097); img012 -> img017 shows the same 8,346,280 CHZ short carried from -$470k to +$2.1M. MEASURED on his own blotters: img113 shows Est. liquidation price 'Infinity'; img007/032/059/060/123 show 'N/A'; img023 sits ~690% from liquidation and img082 ~79%. img125: 'I have unlimited collateral, you don't'. Every measurable case clears the 50% SAFE threshold, which was set from his leverage before these were read.
principles.note: THE disconfirming check. Tests how he carries risk, which survives the regime, rather than which way he points, which does not.

principles.name: Uses exchange subaccounts
principles.claim: Ran multiple FTX subaccounts and viewed them aggregated.
principles.evidence: img007 — 'Show positions on all subaccounts' and 'Group positions across accounts' both enabled.
principles.note: Off-chain and not directly testable, but it is a documented habit of splitting activity across accounts, which is the behaviour this project exists to detect on-chain.

principles.name: Trades basket instruments
principles.claim: Traded FTX's ALTPERP altcoin index, not only single names.
principles.evidence: img175 — ALTPERP 2h chart annotated 'Take profit on SHORTS'.

principles.name: Conviction is not position
principles.claim: Holds long-term conviction in coins he is simultaneously short.
principles.evidence: img219 (Telegram: 'doge is forever, an original classic like bitcoin') against DOGE -19,401,834 short in img089/img096.
principles.note: A warning against inferring belief from a position, or the reverse.

principles.name: Rotates pseudonyms
principles.claim: Has used at least four public identities and discloses old ones later.
principles.evidence: img034 - 'An old prediction I made in August 2020 about $SHIB under the moniker, trueshiba', with the original Discord post quoted.
principles.note: Off-chain, but the same instinct this project hunts on-chain: one operator, several fronts, revealed only in hindsight.

principles.name: Came from prediction markets
principles.claim: Traded political prediction markets full time for years before crypto.
principles.evidence: img186; img185 is a BetFair slip backing Valerie Pecresse at 65-70:1, GBP 49,000 staked for GBP 3,136,000 profit.
principles.note: He is not crypto-native. The tracked wallet's HIP-3 xyz: book is also not crypto - long SP500 and XYZ100 against short MU and SKHX. A real point of similarity, but comfort outside crypto is common among large traders.

principles.name: Capped-downside asymmetry
principles.claim: Structures trades so the loss is small and known while the upside is many multiples: a -1% mental stop, or a bet whose liability is the stake.
principles.evidence: img182 (-1% mental stop on announcement trades), img185 (liability = stake), img178 (cuts small losses regardless of his own bias).
principles.note: Explains 'Trigger Orders (0)' in img032/img059 - the stop is MENTAL, so it never appears as a resting order.

annotations: OI + funding at unsustainable levels, spot buyers exhausted
observed_trades.reading: Called a top on unsustainable open interest and funding, then bought the ~20% flush.

annotations: down arrows marking a September top on every pair

One-sided short book across majors and small caps. 1000SHIB here vs the target's kSHIB is the same instrument family.
No longs at all. Two sizes sit one unit off a round number.
An all-long book. Direction tracks the regime.
Same size carried through a drawdown into profit — the risk posture behind 'nearly impossible to liquidate me'.
Small-cap short on FTX; liquidation price redacted.

review_state.note: Two review passes have now each overturned a check: the first removed hedged_book, the second stopped net_short_bias disconfirming and added liquidation_distance. Continue incrementally.
review_state.how_to_find_blotters: Pixel heuristics FAIL — blotters run 1 row to 9, light (Binance) and dark (FTX); a filter tuned on three light blotters missed img335. Use scripts/contact_sheets.py and look at the grids.
review_state.highest_value_next: Remaining blotters. Positions, sizes and leverage are the only material that compares directly against on-chain data.

The seller side is a GCR-controlled Ethereum address. This is the ONLY thing in the corpus that could move the hypothesis on flow rather than style. Not yet pursued.
